THE WOMAN BEHIND THE CHAIR

Hey babe,
I'm Marisa.

I'm a licensed cosmetologist in Arizona and Nevada, a DreamCatchers certified hair extension specialist, and a creative color artist. I started my education at Paul Mitchell in Costa Mesa, California, and completed my 1,600-hour cosmetology program at Charles of Italy in Bullhead City, Arizona, graduating in August 2026.

My passion is creating personalized hair that makes you feel confident. I specialize in blonding, lived-in color, vivids, gray coverage, and extensions including wefts, I-tips and K-tips. I also love brow services and scalp treatments.
